question_text: Describe the structure of a noncircular doubly linked list, including its boundary links.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Each node contains data, a next reference and a previous reference. Adjacent nodes link both ways. The first node’s previous reference and the last node’s next reference are None. A head reference identifies the first node; a tail reference may provide direct access to the last.
